blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday blamed President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s administration for the recent school shootings, the latest being in South Cotabato, which killed three students. In a statement, Duterte said that the three fatal school shooting incidents recorded this year alone reminded the public that the protection of children is “inevitably compromised” when a government “prioritizes political consolidation over fundamental governance.” READ: South Cotabato school shooting kills 3, hurts 6 “Sumasalamin din ito sa laganap na karahasan sa lipunan na pinalalala ng kabiguan ng pamahalaan na tiyaking ligtas, payapa, at maginhawa ang pamumuhay ng mga Pilipino,” […]...
